items.rationale: Translating the police report is claim substantiation, excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f).
Working material raised alongside the translation charge is excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

The watch is a valuable under 4.2.2 with no valuables schedule, so the EUR 2,500 per-item sub-limit applies after the 7.1.9 betterment cut. An equivalent watch would cost about EUR 7,000, well above the cap; Case 31 suggests the deductible is not visibly deducted.
About EUR 900 cash was taken, but means of payment away from the premises are capped at EUR 500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3.
Mislaid on a separate occasion, so excluded under 2.3.4(a); not an affected item.
Carriage and dispatch charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
